correctness.rationale: Symmetrization preserves three-wise independence and the all-distinct event, reducing the law to seven occupancy partitions. Three-wise independence fixes \(E[T_2]=10/q\) and \(E[T_3]=10/q^2\). Direct inspection of all seven types proves the two pointwise collision-indicator inequalities that yield the upper and lower bounds. The three displayed endpoint mass systems are nonnegative on their stated ranges, sum to one and satisfy both fixed moments. Uniform random labeling of blocks by distinct symbols makes every ordered triple exactly uniform, and convex mixtures fill the entire interval. The inspected verifier checks the symbolic inequalities, formulas through \(q=2000\) and explicit joint laws for \(q=5,\ldots,9\); an independent replay checked all endpoint moments over a separate parameter range.

originality.rationale: Benjamini–Gurel-Gurevich–Peled provide a general extremal and moment-problem framework for \(k\)-wise-independent Boolean distributions, while Pătraşcu–Thorup motivate five-key phenomena in a particular three-independent hashing scheme. A published Resultary theorem gives the all-distinct envelope under pairwise-independent uniforms using only the pair-collision moment. None of these inspected results states the generic five-key, \(q\)-ary, three-wise-independent birthday interval or its endpoint occupancy mixtures.

value.rationale: Five keys are the first size at which the occupancy geometry under three-wise independence has enough structure to exhibit the submitted new endpoint types. The theorem gives the complete attainable birthday interval, exact extremizers and a sharp positivity threshold at \(q=10\), providing a natural finite benchmark for what limited independence alone can guarantee.
residual_risks: An equivalent exact envelope could occur in older orthogonal-array or design-theory literature under terminology not captured by the targeted searches.

final_claim: For five uniform \(q\)-ary random variables with \(q\ge5\) that are three-wise independent, the all-distinct probability ranges exactly over \([\max\{0,(q-1)(q-9)/q^2\},(q^2-5q+10)/q^2]\); both endpoints have explicit occupancy-symmetric realizations and every intermediate value is attainable.
scientific_limitations: An equivalent exact envelope could occur in older orthogonal-array or design-theory literature under terminology not captured by the targeted searches.
The theorem is specific to five keys and arbitrary three-wise-independent laws; a concrete hashing construction may satisfy additional constraints.
